notes: Element IDs, part names and ports for non-catalogue parts are inferred from the inventory page and step pictures. The pictures are dark and low-detail.
Step 1 plates are placed side by side; step 3 plates and step 4 tiles are assumed to bridge the seam between the two base plates. Exact stud-level attachment is approximate.
The step 9 tower is modelled as 4 tubes joined by 4 red axle joiners. A 5th tube (step 10) sits on the top red joiner, and Axle 3 goes into it. A 6th tube is added at step 12 and Axle 5 at step 13.
The step 7 and 14 3-way connector + 3 angle connector sub-assemblies are not put in repeats because they attach to different axles and carry different ids.
The 3 rods (4514198) are cut to 133 mm on page 12. They run from the lower angle connectors to the upper ones. Each is paired with one lower and one upper connector.
Lower angle connector holes are assumed to sit over the dish studs (3 of the 4 studs are covered, one stays visible).
4211475 uses the catalogue port names stud.top and pin.bottom, so the bottom joins use pin.bottom.
Step 8 uses two 4211885 gears, one lower and one upper, plus a bush. The bush in step 12 is placed on Axle 3 near the wheel hub.
